docs(release): bind Koios source/registry/Guix receiving to living application (#5)

Documentation-only integration, not production deployment.

 # Website production
 
-The website package owns rendering and Cloudflare delivery. The newsroom owns
-the property configuration and exact content/data Git revisions. A renderer
-release does not require replacing the newsroom application.
-
-Publish the complete package through Code's source-registry closure producer.
-Its exact registry dependencies and native PNPM lock travel in the artifact.
-Use Guix Node 24 and the declared PNPM 11.28.5; lifecycle scripts stay disabled.
-The former three-source workspace is retired: those libraries are received from
-their living package owners at the versions in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml.
-
-The parent newsroom's config/website-release.json selects the published package,
-SHA-512 integrity, website Git revision and PNPM supplier. Its website workflow
-receives actual registry artifacts with Code, installs the frozen lock and builds
-from the parent revision's exact property/content/data inputs. This uses the
-machine's Guix runtime and existing credential custody.
+The original website package owns rendering and guarded Cloudflare delivery.
+The current writable
+[Koios application](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios.news)
+owns the property configuration, accepted content/data Git revisions, and
+immutable website selection at `config/website-release.json`. Releasing a
+renderer does not by itself install it into the application or deploy its
+Cloudflare pages. The historical `causeway-services/koios-news` parent and
+its `site.yml` workflow are **archived**, so do not try to reactivate that
+historical release path.
+
+Publish the **complete original** website package through Code's
+source-registry closure producer, with its exact dependencies, original
+PNPM lock, and independently verified registry integrity. Use the supported
+Guix Node 24 and declared PNPM 11.28.5. The original
+`pnpm-workspace.yaml` retains strict minimum-release-age and lifecycle
+policy: only exact locked `esbuild@0.28.1` and
+`workerd@1.20260828.1` build hooks are explicitly permitted; there
+is no blanket lifecycle-script execution grant. Do not broaden approvals
+as an installation shortcut. The older three-source workspace is retired:
+libraries are received from their living package owners at the versions in
+the actual source `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
+
+Once an immutable package really exists, the current application must
+select its exact website Git revision, version and SHA-512 digest in its
+own `config/website-release.json`, reconcile the `services/website`
+gitlink, and receive its own dependency/runtime closure through native
+Cold Red Gate [Koios deployment composition](https://github.com/561-group/cold-red-gate-services-section/tree/main/deployment/applications/koios),
+FeltOS and Guix/LAGOON. Preserve original independently admitted publication
+inputs, host credentials and active jobs. The original website
+`src/release.mjs` then owns the manifest comparison, preview, rollback,
+production authorization and independent public verification. A merged
+source change or package-version declaration is **not** registry proof or
+public installation.
+
+## October 21 GEO/SEO release-receiving boundary
+
+Original [website source PR #2](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios-news-site/pull/2)
+merged the canonical NewsMediaOrganization/WebSite publisher IDs with
+166/166 native tests. Original
+[discovery PR #3](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios-news-site/pull/3)
+added two independently checked public-HTML publisher-linkage findings.
+The [2026-10-21T21:22:44Z production audit](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios-news-site/actions/runs/39678276689)
+still returned HTTP 200 pages with **no matching `@id` on the sampled
+home/NewsArticle**. Thus, neither the source merge nor passing source
+tests established that the semantic fix was installed.
+
+The active application's last observed `config/website-release.json`
+selected a **previous** `@causeway-services/koios-news-site@0.1.9`
+artifact and the `services/website` Gitlink pointed at an older
+revision. This source's package metadata declares `0.1.10`, but that
+string is **not evidence of a corresponding accepted registry artifact
+containing the later source commits**. The historical parent
+[October 18 website receipt](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios-news/actions/runs/39139196189)
+settled an older candidate as already live, not the October 21 fixes.
+
+A true receiving record requires: exact qualified immutable package and
+integrity; active application/Guix selection and source inputs; actual
+guarded release receipts; independent live homepage `/#publisher`,
+`/#website` and a real article's `publisher.@id` correspondence;
+unchanged canonical/robots/sitemap/feed, editorial/article history and
+customer-facing behavior. Re-run the existing dependency-free audit to
+witness **`publisher-graph-linkage: pass`** and
+**`article-publisher-linkage: pass`**. Treat missing Google Search Console
+access, article citation depth, and the 20-new-articles-per-day publication
+goal as separate, still-open obligations in the
+[active newsroom](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios.news/issues/40).
+No source document, test or GitHub Action by itself proves higher rankings,
+AI citations, or paid customer receiving.
 
 For an already received runtime, supply absolute publication input paths:

-The parent supplies the property record, corpus, published ledger and source
-archive. Its GitHub Actions workflow owns building, previewing, deployment and
-public verification. A push here updates the parent's pinned site revision.
-
-`src/build.mjs` and `src/render` are the implementation that served the previous
-live site, recovered from engineering's `news-property` application.
-Rendering uses the declared text, theming, HTML metadata and RDF providers
-in the admitted immutable machine artifact. The parent workflow executes
-that artifact with pinned publication inputs; it does not rebuild a separate
-vendored copy or resolve house packages from the laptop. Wrangler remains
-pinned as a production dependency.
-
-Metadata projections bind a named article's original source digest and a dated
-correction. Its admitted body remains unchanged. The parent README describes
-authoring and publication.
+`@causeway-services/koios-news-site` is the **original Koios.News public
+website renderer and guarded Cloudflare release carrier**. Its current,
+writable publishing application is
+[causeway-services/koios.news](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios.news),
+which selects this repository at `services/website`, owns the original
+property configuration, independently accepted content/data inputs and
+`config/website-release.json` package/version/integrity selection. The
+historical [causeway-services/koios-news](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios-news)
+repository is **archived**. Its former GitHub Actions `site.yml` and October
+18 release receipts are retained history, **not current publishing authority**.
+
+A push to this website source **does not automatically update** either
+application's Git submodule, publish an immutable registry package, select it
+in the current application, install a native Guix/LAGOON release or update
+the public Cloudflare Worker. Treat those as distinct real receiving steps.
+
+`src/build.mjs` and `src/render` are the original rendering implementation,
+recovered from engineering's `news-property` application. They consume the
+declared text, theming, HTML metadata and RDF providers from an admitted,
+immutable runtime with exact independently accepted inputs. Current operation
+requires the native
+[Cold Red Gate Koios composition](https://github.com/561-group/cold-red-gate-services-section/tree/main/deployment/applications/koios),
+original site package custody, Cloudflare preview/rollback and separate public
+readback. Wrangler remains pinned. This source does not copy a second renderer
+or make substitute public articles. Metadata changes preserve actual article
+source/rights/editorial authority and corrections, as specified by the
+[current application](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios.news/blob/main/README.md).
 
 ## Publisher discovery and crawl-economy services (Tunesday, 2026-10-13)
 
 This publisher is both a consumer and a test property for a reusable **public-web
 discovery and answer-citation assessment service**. Its programmatic contract lives
 in the existing rendering package, not in a parallel scraper, ephemeral checklist,
 or imitation of a search engine. The owning newsroom remains
-[causeway-services/koios-news](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios-news);
+[causeway-services/koios.news](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios.news);
 the live content/data ledger and its editorial admission are unchanged.
